question: Can full-vocabulary KL refine the stable cross-fit response projectors without exploiting a row-level or unconstrained-subspace shortcut?

frozen_design.search_space: at each of eight sites, the at-most-rank-16 union of the independently fit even/odd response subspaces
frozen_design.checkpoint_selection_targets: complete temporal-v10 and is/was-v11 A1/A2 families
frozen_design.sealed_targets: complete temporal-v11 and is/was-v10 A1/A2 families
frozen_design.target_feasibility: every task must retain signed behavior projection >=0.80 and worst normalized behavior/two-mode residual <=0.05; infeasibility cannot be traded for KL
frozen_design.secondary_objective: worst-family centered-logit error plus full-vocabulary KL for projected matching, target-complement inertness, and control inertness

predictions.pred_a_authority_instrument_hash_finiten: all populations/hashes close, baseline forward reconstruction closes, and all reported values are finite
predictions.pred_b_nonbaseline_family_feasible_check: at least one step>0 checkpoint is target-feasible on every complete selection family
predictions.pred_c_selected_lowers_selection_seconda: selected checkpoint lowers worst-family secondary objective by at least 10% relative to the best frozen start
predictions.pred_d_selected_generalizes_to_sealed_fa: sealed targets remain feasible and sealed controls have margin RMS <=0.10, median KL <=0.02 nat, and top-1 flip fraction <=0.05
predictions.pred_e_refinement_is_stable_and_weight_r: two starts yield projectors with mean squared principal cosine >=0.70 at every site, and exact c_proj/Down contraction closure remains <=1e-10

decision: All five gates promote a KL-refined response program. A selection gain without sealed-family gain is family memorization. Step-zero selection means the frozen response projector is already the transferable frontier under this search class.
